events.text: Requirements I'm checking: (1) a hashed device cookie per link, stored in D1 by migration 0027 and upserted on /enter and on session use; (2) a global device_cap setting (default 20) in Cohort Settings; (3) a Devices column flagged over the cap; (4) the per-attendee override persists after reload; (5) flag only, never block; (6) 0027 applied remotely and the Worker deployed; (7) a live test attendee checked and then deleted; (8) the local admin's device cap retired with a pointer left in its place; (9) committed and pushed; (10) the owner walks the table.
